name: UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter
headline: length
subtitle: UH-60A / UH-60L, rotors turning
description: The Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk is the U.S. Army's main utility helicopter, used for air assault, medical evacuation and command roles; it first flew in 1974 and more than 5,000 have been built. The Army's operator's manual gives an overall length of 64 ft 10 in with the rotors turning and a main rotor diameter of 53 ft 8 in. With the rotors and tail pylon folded for storage it shrinks to 41 ft 4 in long.

measures.label: Overall length (rotors turning)
measures.note: 64 ft 10 in, main rotor tip to tail rotor tip; the Army describes all dimensions as approximate

measures.label: Height
measures.note: 16 ft 10 in, ground to the upper tip path of the canted tail rotor

measures.label: Main rotor diameter
measures.note: 53 ft 8 in; Sikorsky's historical archives give 53.6 ft

measures.label: Maximum gross weight
measures.note: Slick configuration: UH-60A 20,250 lb; UH-60L and UH-60M 22,000 lb

facts.text: The fuselage is 7 ft 9 in wide; with external fuel tanks on the stub wings the helicopter spans 21 ft.
A Black Hawk carries 11 troops, and the UH-60M's cargo hook can lift 9,000 lb.
The Black Hawk first flew on October 17, 1974, and over 5,000 have been delivered, making it Sikorsky's longest production program.

sources.title: TM 1-1520-237-10 Operator's Manual for UH-60A, UH-60L and EH-60A Helicopters (31 October 1996), Figures 2-2 and 2-3
Sikorsky UH-60M Black Hawk helicopter brochure
Sikorsky S-70A: UH-60L Black Hawk Family

caveats: Dimensions come from the Army operator's manual for the UH-60A and UH-60L (hosted on the Internet Archive, distribution statement A: approved for public release). No primary source giving UH-60M overall dimensions was found; Lockheed Martin's product page and UH-60M brochure give weights only.
Lengths are stored in decimal feet converted from the manual's feet-and-inches (for example 64 ft 10 in = 64.83 ft).
The manual's height figure is to the top of the tail rotor's path; the fixed structure and main rotor hub are lower.
